brief.concept: Music video for bZ's 'I Killed Your Dragon' — a lone multicultural warrior crosses a burning mythic kingdom to slay the immortal dragon its empire was built on, and in the ashes inherits the beast's fire, becoming the very terror she destroyed. Hyper-real, HBO-scale, anamorphic 2.39, teal+amber grade; the woman is the dignified, powerful through-line. No superimposed holograms/HUD/overlays — every element photoreal.
brief.mood: mythic, fervent, tragic-triumphant; grief under fury; opulent and scorched

logline: A lone warrior crosses a burning kingdom to slay the immortal dragon its empire was built on — and in the ashes inherits its fire, becoming the very terror she destroyed.
synopsis: Aziza walks alone into a wildfire pass toward a kingdom the dragon has terrorized for generations. The people swear the beast cannot die; she climbs its spine over a molten valley and drives her one notched sword through its skull. But as it falls she sees the truth — the dragon was the empire's foundation, its guardian and its curse — and its surviving fire takes root in her. She rises transformed, ember-eyed and feared, the sky finally turning from blood-red to blue. She did it for the very 'you' who now kneels in terror of her.

characters.name: Aziza
characters.description: A multicultural warrior woman — North African / Middle-Eastern / South-Asian features, late 20s — in bronze scale-mail with henna-marked hands, carrying one notched sword. Dignified and powerful, grief held under fury.
characters.externalGoal: Slay the immortal dragon that terrorizes the kingdom
characters.internalNeed: To be the savior no one else would be — to matter, to avenge the one she lost
characters.contradiction: To kill the monster she must become monstrous — she inherits its fire
characters.voice: Silent and resolute; speaks only in action; fury over grief
vulnerabilities: grief for the one she lost
blindSpots: cannot see that the dragon sustains the empire
cannot see herself becoming the new terror

relationships.red-moon-kingdom: the empire that doubted her and whose power rests on the dragon

locations.name: The Wildfire Pass
locations.description: A towering mountain pass ablaze with wildfire, cold rain falling through the flames; smoke, ember, and a blood-red moon above.

locations.name: The Red-Moon Kingdom
locations.description: A walled mythic kingdom of sun-gold stone and bronze, banners scorched, under a blood-red moon; its scorched walls seem to whisper.

locations.name: The Volcanic Valley
locations.description: A valley glowing molten gold — the dragon's lair; obsidian rock and rivers of lava.

locations.name: The Dragon's Spine
locations.description: The ridged back of the colossal dragon, scales like shields, high above the molten valley.

locations.name: The Ash Plaza
locations.description: The kingdom's great square at dawn, ash falling like snow, the empty throne visible.

props.name: The Notched Sword
props.description: A single notched, battle-worn sword — her only weapon; later alight with the dragon's own fire.

props.name: The Dragon
props.description: A colossal immortal dragon, scales of obsidian and bronze, molten light between its plates — the terror the empire was built on.

wardrobe.name: Bronze Scale-Mail
wardrobe.description: Bronze scale-mail armor over henna-marked leather and a travel-worn cloak; scorches and ember-light accumulate across the film.

setupPayoffs.initialMeaning: Her only, fragile weapon against an immortal beast
setupPayoffs.finalMeaning: Alight with the dragon's own fire as she is crowned by terror

setupPayoffs.initialMeaning: The enemy element, the obstacle in her path
setupPayoffs.finalMeaning: The fire is now inside her — she has become it

setupPayoffs.detail: The blood-red moon over the kingdom
setupPayoffs.finalMeaning: The sky finally turns blue — the old terror gone, replaced by her

scenes.title: Through the Wildfire
scenes.narrativePurpose: Establish the warrior choosing to enter the dragon's domain alone.
scenes.objective: Aziza must cross the burning pass to reach the dragon everyone fears.
scenes.opposition: A wall of wildfire, choking smoke, and a mountain shaking underfoot.

visibleActions.subject: aziza
visibleActions.action: walks straight into a towering wall of wildfire as rain hisses off her bronze armor
visibleActions.subtext: she refuses to wait for a savior

scenes.decision: She steps into the flame instead of turning back.
scenes.change: She crosses from the safe world into the dragon's domain.
scenes.consequence: The kingdom's whisper — 'the dragon's not dead' — reaches her and hardens her resolve.
scenes.audienceLearns: She is alone, armored in fury, hunting a monster everyone else fled.

scenes.title: The Whispering Kingdom
scenes.narrativePurpose: The kingdom's fear reveals the dragon is believed immortal; the beast shows itself.
scenes.objective: Aziza must find the lair as the walled kingdom warns her the dragon cannot die.
scenes.opposition: The kingdom's despair and the sense that the beast is immortal.

visibleActions.subject: aziza
visibleActions.action: presses a henna-marked hand to the scorched city gate as the blood-red moon rises
visibleActions.subtext: the whole kingdom is the dragon's prisoner

scenes.decision: She turns from the cowering gates toward the volcanic glow beyond.
scenes.change: She rejects the kingdom's despair and fixes on the lair.
scenes.consequence: The molten glow becomes her path; the beast stirs, sensing her.
scenes.audienceLearns: The dragon is the empire's terror and its secret foundation.

scenes.title: War-Cry (Vision of Victory)
scenes.narrativePurpose: A flash-forward of triumph — her intent made vision — planting the ashes image paid off for real later.
scenes.objective: Aziza must steel herself; she envisions standing victorious in the ashes.
scenes.opposition: Her own doubt and the beast's overwhelming scale.

visibleActions.subject: aziza
visibleActions.action: raises the notched sword and roars soundlessly into the firelight as embers swirl around her
visibleActions.subtext: she claims a victory she has not yet won

scenes.decision: She commits fully — no retreat, whatever it costs.
scenes.consequence: Her resolve propels her up toward the lair and the beast.
scenes.audienceLearns: Her will may be as dangerous as the dragon itself.

scenes.title: The Climb and the Kill
scenes.narrativePurpose: The literal slaying — she climbs the beast over the molten valley and drives the blade home.
scenes.objective: Aziza must reach the dragon's head and drive her blade through it.
scenes.opposition: The beast's wings, claws, and fire, and the molten drop below.

visibleActions.subject: aziza
visibleActions.action: climbs the dragon's spine over the molten valley and drives her sword through the crown of its skull
visibleActions.subtext: grief and rage spent in a single mortal blow

scenes.decision: She drives the last blade home instead of retreating.
scenes.change: The immortal beast is mortally struck and begins to fall.
scenes.consequence: The fire goes silent; the beast crashes and the kingdom wakes.
scenes.audienceLearns: Even the immortal can be killed by one relentless will.

scenes.title: The Fall
scenes.narrativePurpose: The beast collapses; the kingdom wakes to the sound; the cost lands on her.
scenes.objective: Aziza must survive the beast's collapse and witness what she's done.
scenes.opposition: The dragon's death-throes and the shockwave of its fall.

visibleActions.subject: aziza
visibleActions.action: rides the toppling beast down through smoke and lands kneeling in the ash as the shockwave rolls out
visibleActions.subtext: the cost lands on her as the silence hits

scenes.decision: She stays with the body rather than flee.
scenes.change: The beast is down; the kingdom stirs awake to the sound.
scenes.consequence: The kingdom's people emerge and dawn starts to break.
scenes.audienceLearns: The deed is done — but the silence is not relief.

scenes.title: Ashes at the Edge of Dawn
scenes.narrativePurpose: The vision of s2 made real — she stands in true ashes; the triumph the song declares.
scenes.objective: Aziza must claim the victory aloud over the fallen beast.
scenes.opposition: Her own grief undercutting the triumph.

visibleActions.subject: aziza
visibleActions.action: stands in the real ashes and shouts a name into the breaking dawn over the dead dragon
visibleActions.subtext: the imagined victory is real now, but hollow

scenes.decision: She lets herself claim the win, naming who it was for.
scenes.change: Dread gives way to triumphant release.
scenes.consequence: As she exults, the dragon's surviving spark begins to seek her.
scenes.audienceLearns: The victory is real — and something of the beast remains.

scenes.title: Guardian or Curse
scenes.narrativePurpose: The moral turn: the dragon was the empire's foundation; was she hero or destroyer?
scenes.objective: Aziza must reckon with what the kingdom actually was.
scenes.opposition: The dawning truth that the beast held the empire together.

visibleActions.subject: aziza
visibleActions.action: looks from the dead beast to the crumbling kingdom as its dark blood runs down her arm
visibleActions.subtext: she realizes she may have broken more than she freed

scenes.decision: She accepts the blood on her — she will not disown the deed.
scenes.change: Triumph curdles into cold doubt as the beast's spark enters her.
scenes.consequence: The surviving fire takes root in her; the transformation begins.
scenes.audienceLearns: The dragon guarded the empire's sins; killing it unmakes the kingdom.

scenes.title: I Left as the War
scenes.narrativePurpose: She inherits the dragon's fire and becomes the new terror the kingdom fears.
scenes.objective: Aziza must accept the fire now inside her.

visibleActions.subject: aziza
visibleActions.action: rises as embers ignite in her eyes and molten light runs through her veins while the kingdom kneels in fear
visibleActions.subtext: she has become the very thing she killed

scenes.decision: She embraces the fire instead of fighting it.
scenes.change: The woman becomes a living embodiment of the dragon's fire.
scenes.consequence: The kingdom now fears her as it once feared the beast.
scenes.audienceLearns: In killing the monster she inherited it — the terror simply changed form.

scenes.title: I Did It for You
scenes.narrativePurpose: The quiet, ironic coda: the sky clears, but she is the new power — and it was all for the very 'you' who now fears her.
scenes.objective: Aziza must face the kingdom she saved and transformed.
scenes.opposition: The tenderness of her motive against the terror she now is.

visibleActions.subject: aziza
visibleActions.action: lowers the fire-alight sword and looks over the silent kingdom as the red sky finally turns blue
visibleActions.subtext: everything she became, she became for them

scenes.decision: She turns to face the kingdom rather than vanish.
scenes.change: The red moon yields to blue dawn; the old terror is gone, replaced by her.
scenes.consequence: A new, uneasy peace under a new power — the real quest begins.
scenes.audienceLearns: Love was the engine; the cost was becoming the thing they feared.
